scripts.build: npm run build:content && npm run clean && npm run build:mkdirs && npm run build:css && npm run build:html && npm run copy:assets
scripts.build:css: timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d) && cleancss -o dist/css/styles.min.$timestamp.css css/styles.css && cleancss -o dist/css/reset.min.$timestamp.css css/reset.css
scripts.copy:assets: cp favicon.ico dist/ && cp -r assets/images/* dist/assets/images/ && cp -r assets/fonts/* dist/assets/fonts/ && cp -r assets/content/* dist/assets/content/ && npm run update:html
